bio: Jane Hamilton Davis was born on 21 February 1902 at Pleasant Hill, Sabine Parish, La., the daughter of William Chapman Davis and Mary Virginia Armstrong. She married Leo G. Heffernan in 1922 and was still recorded as Jane Heffernan in 1940. She died in El Paso, Texas, on 21 May 1975 under the name Jane Davis McMaster and was buried at Arlington National Cemetery in Arlington, Va.
